title: Senate Battleground Expands as GOP’s Grip on Majority Tightens into Toss-Up
snippet: Once confident in securing a firm Senate majority, Republicans are now facing an increasingly competitive map as key battleground races shift.
content:
WASHINGTON — What initially looked like a favorable political map for Senate Republicans has transformed into a high-stakes, unpredictable scramble for control of the upper chamber, according to recent polling data and campaign strategists.

Shifting Battlegrounds

GOP strategists who once predicted comfortable victories in key swing states are now pouring emergency resources into races previously considered safe bets. Surging candidate fundraising on the Democratic side and shifting suburban demographics have reopened tight contests, forcing both national parties to recalibrate their late-stage campaign spending.
